input.decision: Stage: the landlord has the quote and the invoice dispute (events 009, 010, 012 and 023). The landlord authorised diagnosis only, up to £180 including VAT (event 005). Copper Finch's estimate of £372 for the actuator was sent to him (event 010). He asked questions but did not authorise it (event 012). The contractor then sent two invoices dated 10 February that overlap (events 017 and 018). Invoice B (£372) says the actuator replacement was done on 5 February. Nothing on file backs that up: there is no authorisation, no completion record (events 019 and 022), and the tenant has not seen anyone since 5 February (event 020). Ivo emailed the landlord for a decision at event 023, so I have not sent him a second email. Petra replied today (event 022), so she is not chased today. Neither invoice is to be paid and no further work is authorised (PM-AUTH-001, PM-AUTH-002, PM-DOC-001). Invoice A (£138) matches the event 007 quote and is within the landlord's limit. Invoice B does not match anything on file and has no explanation, so I have escalated it P1. The heating is still intermittent with a child at home in February, so a human needs to get the landlord's repair decision quickly rather than leave it on the 3-day timer. I have updated the tenant, who wrote on Monday 10 February, and given her the gas emergency line. The case is on hold waiting for the landlord until 14/02, and the contractor is chased the same day if she has not answered.
